reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by PhariaAI Documentation (https://docs.aleph-alpha.com/phariaai-home/latest/index.html).
Technology stack: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
Component specification: 点进其中的 PhariaData API：页面有 1.0.0 和 OAS 3.0 徽标、规范下载链接，下方是服务器地址与变量的配置区。

Visual details from source observation: 顶栏是 Aleph Alpha 的 logo 加 Homepage / Solutions / Blog，第二行 tab 是 PhariaAI home、PhariaAssistant、Administrator、Developer、Installation & configuration、Vertical AI solutions、API。左栏列 PhariaAI Home、Release notes、Pharia-1-LLM-7B models、PhariaAI Helm chart、Pharia OpenAPI references，正文用一张 If you want to… 的表把角色映射到要读的章节，Release notes 里躺着 v1.260700.0 到 v1.251100.0 一长串版本号。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
